name: toopo
description: Copy utility functions into your project, each verified against a public, executable contract. Not a dependency: the source lands in your repository and it is yours.
author: Mathis Perron <hello@toopo.dev>

scripts.registry: tsc -p registry/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config registry/vitest.config.ts
scripts.validation: tsc -p validation/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config validation/vitest.config.ts
scripts.cli: tsc -p cli/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config cli/vitest.config.ts
scripts.site: tsc -p site/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config site/vitest.config.ts
scripts.packaging: tsc -p packaging/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config packaging/vitest.config.ts
